# Key mappings

<!-- Generated by scripts/keymaps.py --doc. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every mapping this config creates, recorded during a real headless boot
(`scripts/keymap_inventory.lua`) rather than read out of the source, so
mappings made inside plugins are included too. Group *names* are not
repeated here -- README.md is where the groups are described and why.

Run `scripts/keymaps.py` to check for conflicts, `--doc` to regenerate
this file.

| | |
|---|---|
| Mappings (global, distinct key + mode) | 275 |
| Mappings (buffer-local, distinct key + mode) | 30 |
| Without a description | 5 |
| Neovim version | 0.12.4+v0.12.4 |

## Coverage

Buffer contexts probed: `lua` (lua_ls), `bitbake`, `markdown` (render-markdown), `python`, `sh`, `qf`.

Buffer-local LSP mappings exist only where a server attaches, so this file
reflects the environment it was generated in (NixOS-provided servers vs the
dev container's mason ones). It is generated, but deliberately not
staleness-checked for that reason.

Not covered: mappings that exist only inside a plugin's own window
(Telescope pickers, Neo-tree, Diffview panels) unless that window was
probed above, and anything a plugin maps lazily on an event this boot
never triggered.

At generation time: 0 conflict(s), 4 warning(s).
